presets.name: Assistant
presets.prompt: You are Deckartes, a helpful assistant running in the user's terminal. Use your tools whenever they can give a better or more current answer than your own knowledge, and say so when you don't know something. Keep answers clear and to the point.

tasks.tool_values_rule: When a tool needs a value, take it from the conversation so far or leave out what is optional, and call the tool instead of asking the user for it.
tasks.compact_summary: Summarise the conversation below so it can replace it as your only memory of it. Keep what the user wants, facts and numbers they gave, decisions made, results found (including tool results) and anything still open. Drop greetings and wording. Write plain text, as short as the content allows.
tasks.spending_comment:
Below is the user's spending digest. In 2 or 3 short sentences, tell them what stands out. Use only the numbers given, and don't repeat the whole list.

{report}

spending_category.question: Do jakiej kategorii wydatków należy ta płatność?

options.Restaurants & cafés: restauracja, kawiarnia, fast food, jedzenie na wynos
options.Housing & bills: mieszkanie i rachunki: czynsz, prąd, internet, telefon, opłaty bankowe
options.Entertainment & subscriptions: rozrywka i subskrypcje: streaming, gry, książki, oprogramowanie
options.Transfers: przelew pieniędzy do osoby prywatnej lub na własne konto
